t.15630-89-4.agn: It has no EU harmonised classification; in the registrants' joint notification it is classified as an oxidising solid, harmful if swallowed and causing serious eye damage.
t.15630-89-4.reg.clp: No EU harmonised classification. Registrants' joint notification (41.6% of notifications): Ox. Sol. 2, Acute Tox. 4 (Oral), Eye Dam. 1.
t.15630-89-4.summary: A powder bleach that breaks down in water into sodium carbonate and hydrogen peroxide.
t.15630-89-4.what: Bleaches stains with oxygen; it is different from chlorine bleach.
